title: N3on at TwitchCon: Real Talk, Friends, and Epic Merch Reveal
description:
Clips from N3on's live streams on Kick (https://kick.com/n3on) | Unofficial fan channel, not affiliated.
N3on meets fans and industry peers at TwitchCon, sharing personal stories about injuries, gaming, and community support. Highlights include a surprise GTA 6 reveal, an exclusive No‑Look Handshake Club merch drop, and a heartfelt conversation about family goals and education. The session ends with a playful mukbang plan and a promise to collaborate on future streams.
